Maria: tiny robe or tiny towel? :thinking_face:

Lina: robe with hood pls, obviously :laughing:
Claire: poll closed: robe wins 4-1. ordering a miniature robe now :rofl:
OpsBot: @Claire reminder set — post Nimbus robe arrival photo in #random in 3 days
Sam: can we have a Nimbus runway when it arrives? I will bring applause samples
Claire: yes runway. also accept sponsorships (catnip/treats) :sweat_smile:
Maria: putting Nimbus on the calendar for morale duties weekly :sparkles:
Claire: thanks gang, low-effort hydrating content for the afternoon :)
